beschreibung: The mine telephone made by the company Funke & Huster GmbH has been installed in the shaft-hall of the LWL-Industrial Museum Zollern Colliery since 1990. This device had originally been in use in the Ewald Colliery in Herten (Germany, North Rhine-Westphalia). In coal mining, mine telephones enable communication between the shaft- operations personnel and the hoisting operator, among other things.
